images.name: platform-agent
images.pulledBy: The agent Deployment the operator renders, and its sandbox init container.
images.description: Chat, Platform, and Cluster Agent workspaces on the Hermes base image.

images.name: credential-proxy
images.pulledBy: The credential-proxy sidecar in the agent pod.
images.description: The platform-agent image plus the Envoy-based credential proxy runtime.

images.name: k8s-operator
images.description: The Kubebuilder controller manager reconciling PlatformAgent resources.

images.name: litellm
images.pulledBy: The LiteLLM gateway, from either the chart or the kustomize integration.
images.description: The model gateway the agent's baked default endpoint points at.

images.name: fluent-bit
images.pulledBy: The logging sidecar the operator injects into every agent pod.
images.description: Ships agent container logs off the pod.

images.name: github-token-minter-server
images.description: Mints short-lived GitHub App tokens for the GitOps workflow.

images.name: cert-manager-controller
images.pulledBy: cert-manager, installed by provision_03 unless SKIP_CERT_MANAGER is set.
images.description: Issues the webhook serving certificates the operator's webhooks need.

images.name: cert-manager-cainjector
images.pulledBy: cert-manager, installed by provision_03 unless SKIP_CERT_MANAGER is set.
images.description: Injects CA bundles into webhook configurations.

images.name: cert-manager-webhook
images.pulledBy: cert-manager, installed by provision_03 unless SKIP_CERT_MANAGER is set.

images.name: cert-manager-acmesolver
images.pulledBy: cert-manager's controller, via its --acme-http01-solver-image flag. Never pulled by kube-agents itself, but provision_03 rewrites the flag onto the mirror along with the rest of the manifest, so the copy has to exist.
images.description: Solver pod cert-manager runs for ACME HTTP-01 challenges.

images.name: hermes-agent
images.description: The Hermes harness the agent images are built on.

images.description: Source of the envoy binary copied into the credential-proxy image.
